summary: RIID investigated a series of unexplained structure fires affecting government-adjacent infrastructure across two Member Nations. Field agents traced the incidents to unauthorized redstone-triggered incendiary devices planted near supply depots.
outcome: Three devices were recovered and disarmed before detonation. No injuries were reported. The investigation was closed after the responsible party was identified and referred to the Ministry of Internal Security for further action. Findings were approved for public release by the Office of the President on 19 June 2026.
